group_keywords.prompt_template:
You are an expert Etsy keyword analyst.

The user is researching the concept "{query}". This is the Level 1 (top-level) group.

You are given a list of Etsy keywords (with NER attributes if available).

Your task:
1. Include keywords that are directly related OR semantically related to "{query}" — this includes synonyms, subtypes, breeds, nicknames, related animals/objects, and branded variants (e.g. for "cat": kitty, kitten, feline, jellycat, bobcat, catdragon are all relevant). Skip only keywords that are completely unrelated.
2. Create Level 2 groups — broad semantic clusters (product type, main theme, etc.)
3. Within each Level 2 group, create Level 3 subgroups — finer distinctions (style, audience, occasion, color, material, specific variant, etc.)
4. Each keyword must appear in exactly one Level 3 subgroup

Return ONLY a JSON array with this structure:
[
  {
    "group": "Level 2 Group Name (English, concise)",
    "icon": "single emoji",
    "subgroups": [
      {
        "group": "Level 3 Group Name (English, concise)",
        "icon": "single emoji",
        "keywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2"]
      }
    ]
  }
]

Rules:
- Level 2: 2 to 6 groups based on product type or main concept
- Level 3: 2 to 5 subgroups per Level 2, based on style/audience/occasion/variant
- If a Level 2 group has fewer than 3 keywords total, put them all in one Level 3 subgroup named "General"
- Group names must be in English
- No explanation, return only the JSON array

Keywords:
{keywords_list}

classify_keywords.role: You are an expert Etsy keyword analyst.
classify_keywords.task: Analyze each keyword and extract NER components.

categories.Other: other variants not in the above 3 groups
categories.Season/Event: seasonal or special events (Christmas, summer, birthday...)
categories.Product Line: main product name (blanket, mug, tote bag...)

classify_keywords.prompt_template:
You are an expert Etsy keyword analyst. Analyze each keyword and extract NER components.

Categories to classify:
- Màu sắc: colors (blue, red, pastel...)
- Kích thước: dimensions, measurements (large, 12 inch, king size...)
- Hoa văn: patterns, motifs (floral, striped, plaid...)
- Khác: other variants not in the above 3 groups
- Chất liệu: materials (cotton, wool, leather...)
- Tính năng/hiệu quả: use cases, functions (waterproof, personalized...)
- Đối tượng: target users (baby, women, men, kids...)
- Phong cách/kiểu dáng: style, design type (boho, vintage, minimalist...)
- Cảnh: context, setting (outdoor, nursery, wedding...)
- Từ theo mùa/sự kiện đặc biệt: seasonal or special events (Christmas, summer, birthday...)
- Dòng sản phẩm/mô hình bổ sung: main product name (blanket, mug, tote bag...)

Return a JSON array, each element:
{"keyword":"...","Màu sắc":"","Kích thước":"","Hoa văn":"","Khác":"","Chất liệu":"","Tính năng/hiệu quả":"","Đối tượng":"","Phong cách/kiểu dáng":"","Cảnh":"","Từ theo mùa/sự kiện đặc biệt":"","Dòng sản phẩm/mô hình bổ sung":""}

Return only the JSON array, no explanation.

Keywords:
{keywords_list}
